messages:
Ivy Park: Quick thread for the launch SEO checklist for our April webinar landing. Need: redirect plan, canonical target, JSON-LD event schema, internal link anchors from evergreen blog/docs, and GA4->SFDC mapping. Live 04/20.

Liam Ortiz: I can take redirects + canon audit. Can someone share the list of legacy pages to collapse?

Priya Singh: Uploaded top 12 GA4 paths to the sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheet/abc123 (edit). Draft hero: "Watch how Redwood Dedicated reduces inference latency and cost in production 5-minute demo + benchmark walkthrough." Thoughts?

Nora B.: Suggest shortening hero to: "Demo + benchmarks: cut latency, cut cost." Also we should surface 2 internal links: /blog/infra-performance and /docs/deploy/overview.

Ivy Park: Good call. Liam, set canonical to /webinar-dedicated-2026. Also prefer 301 redirects. CDN window is limited per cdn-bot.

Liam Ortiz: Draft redirects (abridged):
```
/old-webinar-2024 -> /webinar-dedicated-2026 (301)
/blog/latency-playbook -> /blog/infra-performance (301)
/docs/setup-v1 -> /docs/deploy/overview (301)
```
I'll run a crawl after the redirects are staged.

Priya Singh: Benchmark blurb for page: "In reproducible demo runs, Redwood Dedicated delivered median p95 latency of ~115ms and reduced cost per 1k tokens by ~47% compared to our baseline. See the gated benchmark report for methodology."

Ivy Park: Nice. For JSON-LD, include startDate, VirtualLocation URL, and speaker array. Nora, can you add speaker bios as linked anchors?

Nora B.: Will add short bios and link to /team. Also pushing two internal links in the FAQ.

Ivy Park: GA4 -> SFDC mapping: include utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, demo_variant. Liam, ensure form hidden fields are present or Alex can add.

cdn-bot: CDN deploy window available 04/18 23:00-01:00 UTC. 301 redirects supported. Please file deploy ticket 24h prior.

Liam Ortiz: I'll stage redirects and run Screaming Frog tonight, then post results here. :white_check_mark:

Priya Singh: I'll finalize copy in the sheet by 5pm and paste gated report link.

Ivy Park: Perfect. Final owners: redirects+canon (Liam), JSON-LD+head (Liam), hero & report link (Priya), internal links+bios (Nora), GA4/SFDC mapping (Alex - FYI). I'll compile the launch brief and ping stakeholders.
